blurb: Sugarloaf Marina is an "old school" full service marina located at MM17 in the Florida Keys. It offers boat rentals including pontoons for experienced boaters, kayak and paddleboard rentals for paddling in mangrove creeks, fishing charters with local guides, and eco tours exploring the Lower Keys backcountry. The marina has been a community hub and home to fishing guides and anglers for decades.
